_help: Each source is either a Google News search (type: gnews, with a query) or a direct RSS feed (type: rss, with a url). section: govt | news | research | global. Add or remove entries freely. State-level stories are intentionally excluded (see TAGGING.md). Global = school-education reports, policy briefs and research only (no country news): direct feeds first, then targeted searches of each organisation's own site. windowDays = how far back a source looks (seen items are never repeated).
